article.title: Attackers Exploit UnrealIRCd Flaw That Enables Server-Level Command Injection
article.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Friday added a high-severity security flaw impacting UnrealIRCd, an open-source Internet Relay Chat (IRC) server, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, following reports of active exploitation. article.title: PostgreSQL Patches 52 Flaws, Including 22-Year-Old Bug Enabling Authenticated RCE
article.summary: A type confusion flaw in PostgreSQL lets a database user who can create objects run code on the server. Updates released yesterday fix it, along with 51 other security flaws. Full protection from this flaw also requires rebuilding any C-language extensions installed on the server. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-6460, has a CVSS score of 8.8. article.title: Citrix Patches 10 Critical NetScaler Vulnerabilities
article.summary: Successful exploitation could lead to unexpected behavior or denial-of-service (DoS) conditions. The post Citrix Patches 10 Critical NetScaler Vulnerabilities appeared first on SecurityWeek .

article.title: City of Osaka warns of data breach impacting 1 million as Japan reels from dozens of cyber incidents
article.summary: Osaka, Japan's third-largest city, told its 2.8 million residents to be wary of suspicious emails purporting to come from the local government.

items.relevance_reason: Thành phố Osaka cảnh báo về sự cố rò rỉ dữ liệu ảnh hưởng đến khoảng 1 triệu người dân trong bối cảnh làn sóng tấn công mạng tại Nhật Bản.
